about.title: Hi, i'm Mauro Cubilla
about.description: Fullstack Developer specializing in React, Typescript and Next.js building projects and continuously learning. Looking to join a team where I can continue to grow as a developer and contribute effective solutions.

projects.title: Hardware E-commerce
projects.description: E-commerce platform for computer hardware, designed with scalability in mind and prepared for future features such as a custom PC builder.
highlights: Authentication system using Auth.js, JWT, and secure password hashing
Backend built with PostgreSQL and Prisma ORM
State management with Redux Toolkit
Search functionality with debounce for better performance
Shopping cart with persistent state using LocalStorage
Responsive mobile-first design

projects.title: MERN Recipes Social Network
projects.description: Full stack MERN application that allows users to create, share, and search recipes, interact through comments and ratings, and add favorites. Secured with password hashing and JWT-based authentication.
highlights: States management with Redux Toolkit
authentication with protected routes using JWT
Full CRUD with validations
Recipe comments functionality
Dynamic forms using React Hook Form
Image upload with Cloudinary
Category filtering, pagination, and sorting
Search with debounce for performance optimization
Dynamic rating system with automatic average calculation
User profile with statistics (created recipes and favorites)

projects.title: Weather App
projects.description: Weather app that uses Mapbox API for real-time location autocomplete and OpenWeather API to display current weather and a 5-day forecast based on precise coordinates.
highlights: Location autocomplete using Mapbox API
Weather data fetching with Axios
5-day forecast display
Responsive design
Dynamic weather icons based on API response
Loading state handling for better user experience
API integration using latitude and longitude coordinates

projects.title: Task Manager
projects.description: Task management application with deadline visual feedback. Tasks can include optional due dates, dynamically changing color depending on remaining time.
highlights: Task creation through modal
Persistent state using LocalStorage
Optional deadline with dynamic color indicators
Visual priority system based on remaining days
Completed tasks styled with strike-through and disabled editing
Date handling with date-fns
Responsive design
